Name: Tinky Winky over Sebastian
Author: kohikii
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod visually replaces Sebastian with Tinky Winky from Teletubbies. Currently does not affect winter or beach Sebastian, nor dialogue. All of Tinky Winky's portraits and sprites are hand-drawn by me, in Piskel.
[/color][/size]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install the mod and place it directly in your "mods" folder. It should have a content.json, manifest.json, and an "assets" folder with his portraits and sprites.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Replaces Sebastian's overworld sprites with Tinky Winky[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Replaces Sebastian's portraits with Tinky Winky[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Replaces Sebastian's name with Tinky Winky
DOES NOT affect beach, winter, or dialogue. As it gets updated, this will change, and his dialogue/other sprites will be different.
This mod is planned to contain more Teletubbies in the future. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires Pathoschild's Content Patcher and SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)[/color]

Manifest.Name: Tinky Winky over Sebastian
Manifest.Description: Turns Sebastian into Tinky Winky from Teletubbies.
